$comment: All house gates, armed. Every edit-time hook this project defines runs here: the sealed primitive vocabulary and the icon rule, the layout grammar, component shape and MVVM, the framework-freeloader rules, and the enforcement guard that keeps this configuration read-only. The boot and responsive checks are separate commands the build is told to run (npm run check:boot, npm run check:responsive), because they need a rendered application and cannot be a per-edit hook.
